newsitem.title: USA: StorMedia shareholder files class action.
newsitem.headline: StorMedia shareholder files class action.

text.p: A StorMedia Inc shareholder filed a class-action suit alleging the company and certain officers violated California state business codes, the law firm representing the plaintiff said Wednesday.

The plaintiff, Sara Werczberger, who is being represented by San Diego-based Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP, filed the suit on behalf of all shareholders who bought StorMedia shares from November 27, 1995, through August 9, 1996.

The suit contends that the stock rose to $30 a share based on company statements, then fell in June after StorMedia said demand was softer than expected and warned that second- and third-quarter earnings would decline.
StorMedia Treasurer Henry Lou declined to comment on the suit.
